question: What are each NBA regular season's (2014-15 to 2025-26) league and team inputs to Poropudas and Halme's four-factor offensive rating (Eq. 11), the share of possession-ending free throws mu, and the offensive-rebound rates after missed twos, threes and final free throws, counted from play-by-play?
inputs: PlayByPlayV3 regular-season archives 2014-15 to 2025-26 (shufinskiy/nba_data, the same retained bytes R05 and R06 read), pinned by SHA-256 in parameters.archive_sha256. Every season complete (1,230 games; 1,059 in 2019-20 and 1,080 in 2020-21); no unknown free-throw text (docs/evidence/research/r10/data-check.json).

Method: J. Poropudas and T. Halme, 'Decomposing Basketball Team Efficiency Using the Four Factors and Shapley Values', arXiv:2305.13032v2 (2026; v1 2023 as 'Dean Oliver's Four Factors Revisited'), Eqs. (9)-(11) and Appendix A, read from the arXiv PDF.
method: COUNTS per offensive team: field-goal attempts and makes (threes by shotValue 3), free throws by trip kind (the R06 classifier: two-shot, three-shot, and-one, technical, flagrant, clear path, other lone free throw), points, turnovers (team turnovers included; 'No Turnover' rows skipped). A row's team is its teamId, or its personId when teamId is 0 (team rebounds and team turnovers). A row with neither is unattributed: reported, kept out of every total.

POSSESSION-ENDING FREE THROWS: 'Free Throw 2 of 2', 'Free Throw 3 of 3', and a lone free throw that is not an and-one. mu = possession-ending free throws / all free throws, per season (paper Appendix A).

REBOUNDS AFTER A MISS: after a missed field goal (two or three), a missed possession-ending free throw, or a missed and-one, the next rebound row is offensive if its team is the shooter's, else defensive. A shot, free throw, turnover or period end before any rebound leaves the miss unrebounded (counted, outside the rates). Rebound rows after a missed non-final free throw are dead-ball placeholders and skipped. Rate = offensive / (offensive + defensive) per miss kind.

INPUTS (paper): eFG% = (FGM + 0.5 3PM)/FGA; FTr = FTM/FGA; FG%; FT%; ORB = all offensive rebounds above (team rebounds included, as the paper's footnote requires); ORB% = ORB/(FGA - FGM) (Eq. 9); TOV% = TOV/(FGA + TOV - ORB + mu FTA) (Eq. 10). ORTG = 100 (1 - TOV%)(FTr + 2 eFG%)/(1 - ORB%(1 - FG%) + mu FTr/FT%) (Eq. 11), which must equal 100 PTS/(FGA + TOV - ORB + mu FTA) (Eq. 3) exactly.
LEAGUE AND TEAM: league inputs from the summed counts with the season's mu; each team's inputs with the same league mu (Proposition 1, not Remark 1's team mu).
MARGINALS: change in Eq. (11) ORTG for +1 percentage point of eFG% (with FG%), FTr, FT%, ORB%, and -1 point of TOV%, the others fixed.
ALSO REPORTED: beta = make rate of possession-ending free throws; alpha = offensive-rebound rate after a missed possession-ending free throw; 2P%, 3P%, 3PA rate, TS% (0.44 FTA).
selection: Nothing is chosen: the counting rules are fixed here and applied once to every season.
uncertainty: None: these are complete-season counts, not samples. The paper's own comparison (Table 7) reports Eq. (11) against play-by-play ORTG; CourtLens does not re-estimate that error here.
evaluation: Per season: mu, beta, alpha, league inputs, Eq. (3) and Eq. (11) ORTG, marginals, rebound rates by miss kind, coverage.
Per team-season: the same inputs and ORTG.
mu, alpha and beta for 2024-25 compared with the paper's 0.425, 0.131 and 0.795 (reported, not a gate).
acceptance: Eq. (11) equals Eq. (3) for every league and team season to within 1e-9.
Two `reproduce` runs give the frozen results hash.
The API serves every number with its unknown state, and the page's values equal the API's.
limitations: Regular seasons 2014-15 to 2025-26 only: the pinned play-by-play archives start in 2014-15.
Possessions use the paper's box-score approximation (Eq. 2) with the season's mu, not exact play-by-play possession counts.
A team's inputs use the league mu; the paper shows team mu varies a little (Remark 1).
Rebound attribution follows the play-by-play order; rare out-of-order rows can move a rebound between kinds.
negative_result_policy: Publish every season's counts and rates as computed, including any disagreement with the paper's published 2024-25 values.
